findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_domain_readiness · Private data: profile_mcp_tools, check_spf_dmarc_syntax, audit_openapi_spec · Public sink: audit_domain_readiness.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_domain_readiness · Private data: profile_mcp_tools, check_spf_dmarc_syntax, audit_openapi_spec · Public sink: audit_domain_readiness

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
